name: Taira no Kiyomori
contribution: A Japanese military leader and kugyō of the late Heian period, who was Daijō-daijin and the de facto ruler of Japan from 1167 until his death.
image_credit: Artist: Fujiwara Tamenobu (藤原為信 - ためのぶ) and Takenobu (豪信 たけのぶ) (both dates of birth and death unknown). Late Kamakura period. · Public domain

checks.lead: Taira no Kiyomori (平 清盛; Japanese pronunciation: [taꜜi.ɾa no | kʲi.joꜜ.mo.ɾʲi], 1118 – March 20, 1181) was a Japanese military leader and kugyō of the late Heian period, who was Daijō-daijin and the de facto ruler of Japan from 1167 until his death. He established the first samurai-dominated administrative government in the history of Japan.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
